verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents broad programmatic coverage. Python and TypeScript SDKs handle tracing, span querying, prompt sync, evaluations and datasets/experiments. A remote MCP endpoint can "search, query, and operate on" projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts and annotations. However, nothing documents that the API matches the UI feature for feature. Some features, such as configuring dataset evaluators and attaching human annotations, are described only as UI workflows, and the OpenAPI probe on arize.com found no public spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a documented REST/OpenAPI reference, API coverage of UI-only flows (evaluator configuration, playground/span replay, annotations), and independent corroboration.
